Folded the reposync round-trip review (reviews/reposync-roundtrip.json @ 76e7ece: P1 LFS history, P2 sparse config, P2 sparse restore Exact) into delta D15 (doc 64803ab), without touching the active reposync lanes.
Coordinator decisions:
- (a) Unpublished-history LFS detection = per-commit attributes (read-only `git check-attr --source=<commit>`) UNION strict pointer-spec parsing of small blobs. It never depends on the current worktree .gitattributes, so a missing required object is MissingLFSError and never Complete/Ready.
- (b) Sparse config is read case-insensitively, plus the per-worktree config.
- (c) Full-checkout expansion stays the default (no receiver repo config mutation), but it is reported honestly: Exact=false, a Difference naming the expansion and the source patterns, and Restored.Sparse. An explicit ApplySparse re-applies the patterns (documented worktreeConfig side effect). cc-sync surfaces the expansion and offers --apply-sparse.
Execution: Run wf_bf82144b-94d on branch cc-sync/worktree-d15 from 76e7ece (worktree /Users/yasyf/.claude/worktrees/reposync/d15). The reviewer's reproductions are written as failing real git/git-lfs tests first, then fixed. Astra verification also tries macro/negated/nested/info attributes and attribute changes within the unpublished range; a fix pass follows. The budget/Partial path passed review and is unchanged.
Final reposync landing = one merge lane over the integration review-fix (cc-sync/worktree-snapshot), the D13/D14 delta (cc-sync/worktree-delta) and D15 (cc-sync/worktree-d15), followed by a whole-diff astra review.
Also: cc-sync phase-1 wiring is complete (capture ae4cd0d, resident 668910e, pickup 284fca1, service 566a0a4); merge2 is running.
